page_desc: Discover and join various active clubs in the Faculty of Arts.
section_desc: Discover and explore active student clubs in our faculty

detail.default_activities_desc: We are a student club under the {{category}} category, Faculty of Arts, Chulalongkorn University. Founded to bring together students with shared interests to create activities, exchange knowledge, and relax from intensive classes.
detail.default_act01_desc:
Weekly gatherings to practice, develop skills, and build relationships among members, preparing for exhibitions and faculty sports/arts events.

We organize activities every week in a friendly, fun, and stress-free atmosphere. Join us anytime, regardless of prior experience!
detail.default_act02_desc:
Special workshops and seminars designed to introduce our club's activities to non-members and interested students.

Held once per semester, we consistently receive positive feedback from Faculty of Arts students thanks to the dedication of our club members.
detail.default_ach01_desc: Highlighting our club's activities and members' experiences to welcome new freshmen, successfully attracting massive interest.
detail.default_ach02_sub: Lawn in front of Faculty of Engineering (Joint Event)
detail.default_ach02_desc: Showcasing our annual achievements in joint university/faculty events, promoting friendship and the Faculty of Arts image.

club04.about: Are you tired of intensive studying in Arts Chula? Our club invites everyone to shake hips and dance to forget EastCiv, WestCiv, Reasoning, EngII, or whatever else hurts your soul. Join us now!
club04.activities_text: Tired of studying? Our club invites everyone to dance and have fun to forget EastCiv, WestCiv, Reasoning, Eng II, or whatever affects your mental health. Come join our ballroom dance family!

act01.title: Insane 1,000-Hour Continuous Social Dance
act01.desc: Through hardship and joy, dance takes us beyond limits. No matter how much it hurts, the music keeps us going. We dance to express, not to impress. Join our journey!

act02.title: Insane 1,000-Hour Continuous Social Dance
act02.desc: Why remember the sadness when we can dance the night away. Every beat is a new beginning, every move is a story untold. Find your rhythm in our club!
